title: China censorship today: multiple layers elevated together in the latest board synthesis
dek: 5 of 10 selected censorship instruments are current. The evidence spans attention, silence, network interference, erasure, and app distribution, but their denominators remain separate.
thesis: China's information controls must be read as separate content, network, erasure, and distribution measurements rather than one seductive national score.

sections.heading: The board detects movement, not motive

sentences.text: Upstream board reports: MULTI-LAYER CO-MOVEMENT: content + network elevated together. 35 of 38 configured sources report; 18 are live. Health qualifiers: 2 degraded, 15 stale, 3 missing. The board-wide e-value is 214.429; the predeclared board alarm threshold is 20.
The board statistic tests whether named signals moved beyond their own histories; it does not identify one cause for the movement.
The current coverage audit marks 0 signal as confounded by its measurement coverage.

sections.heading: Attention, silence, and erasure answer different questions

sentences.text: The current deletion-directive index ranks 211 terms with documented censorship provenance.
No current finding is published for Silence index because the source status is stale.
No current finding is published for Erasure observatory because the source status is stale.

The directive index counts provenance-bound terms, the silence index tests a predeclared blackout rule, and the erasure index summarizes heterogeneous layers; placing them together does not create one censorship rate.

sections.heading: Network measurements agree on scope, not on one denominator

sentences.text: No current finding is published for Network vantage fusion because the source status is stale.
No current finding is published for OONI Great Firewall index because the source status is stale.
No current finding is published for Inside-China view because the source status is stale.
The fused index, volunteer-probe aggregate, and fixed inside-China panel use different samples and protocols, so none can be substituted for a national share of traffic or users.

sections.heading: App availability needs both a fixed panel and a broad corpus

sentences.text: The current panel finds 60% of 10 tracked apps unavailable in the China storefront.
The current AppleCensorship corpus reports 28.11% unavailable among 110,179 tested apps for mainland China.
The fixed panel supports controlled same-round comparison, while the broad corpus improves catalogue coverage; neither percentage identifies why an individual app is absent.
At the edition clock, 5 of 10 selected instruments publish current claims and 5 publish availability warnings instead.
The defensible conclusion is a layered description of current observations, not a single estimate of censorship prevalence or intent.

counterreadings.text: A quiet silence-index round is evidence that no topic met that exact blackout rule; it is not evidence that information controls were absent.
A high anomaly or blocked-panel value can contain ordinary network or sampling failures, so controls and method-specific denominators remain decisive.
Storefront unavailability can reflect policy, licensing, commercial, or technical causes; the comparison does not assign motive.

limitations.text: The selected instruments are complementary but are not automatically independent; several consume related public measurement ecosystems.
Coverage varies by feed, place, network, topic, and catalogue, so the article does not estimate an unseen national denominator.
The current article is an aggregate instrument read and contains no interviews or person-level evidence.

methodology.detail: Accept only the closed aggregate newsroom feed and its current availability semantics.
Copy each selected claim, metric, timestamp, input hash, and first interpretation limit without rewriting the evidence.
Place instruments beside one another only when the prose preserves their separate samples, units, and denominators.
Turn every non-live story into an explicit availability warning and never reuse its retained metric as current.
